test_title: PYST 7: SSC MTS 2023 - English (Held On: 05 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.

A night alone / in a hotel / can be lonely prospect.
solution:
The correct answer is '**can be lonely prospect**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error in the sentence is in the phrase **'can be lonely prospect'**.
 
• The article **'a'** is missing before the word **'lonely.'**
 
• The correct phrase should be **'can be a lonely prospect.'**
 
• Articles such as **'a' or 'an'** are necessary before singular countable nouns.

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1.

Correct sentence: *A night alone in a hotel **can be a lonely prospect***.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: 'A night alone'** - This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not contain any error.
 
• **Option 3: 'No error'** - This option is incorrect because there is an error in the sentence.
 
• **Option 4: 'in a hotel'** - This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not contain any error.
